title: Modern Nashville Townhome · Minutes to Broadway
description:
This modern Nashville townhome offers a flexible layout with multiple living and sleeping areas, ideal for couples, friends, or small groups. The home includes a living room, master bedroom, loft, mezzanine, and additional lounge, providing space to relax or unwind. Contemporary yet comfortable, it features high-speed internet, a Nest thermostat, smart door access, 55" TV, a Sony PS3 with games and Guitar Hero, giant Jenga, and a fully equipped kitchen with cookware and barware.

The space
The townhome is laid out across multiple levels, offering both shared gathering areas and quieter private spaces. The open living and kitchen area is perfect for relaxing or entertaining, while the loft, mezzanine, and lounge provide additional flexibility for sleeping or downtime.

Guest access
Guests will have private access to the entire home.

Individualized door codes will be sent the day before arrival. On the day of check-in, guests will receive a follow-up message with access instructions, property details, and local recommendations to ensure a smooth arrival.

Other things to note
Food delivery services such as Uber Eats and Instacart work well in this area and provide a convenient option for meals during your stay. We recommend downloading the app in advance if you plan to use delivery services.
